family_note: Own pure-JavaScript decoder with no dependencies (packet.js over its bit reader lib/reader.js); 5 of its 1,602 distinct non-test source lines occur in dns-packet 5.6.1. The package also ships UDP/TCP/DoH clients and servers; the harness only calls Packet.parse and constructs no client or server. dns2 decodes the reserved Z bit, AD and CD as separate header fields, which the harness packs into z. A and AAAA text are dns2's own (its toIPv6 compresses the longest zero run). The harness rejects a parse that reports per-record DecodeErrors. Because the documented entry point is require('dns2'), module-load lines of the client and server files count toward the package line total; packet.js alone covers 767 lines on the response control.

scope: RFC 1035 message from local bytes: header flags, questions and CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers with compressed names
family_note: Own JavaScript state-machine decoder (packet.js) reading through its buffercursor dependency; native-dns (a resolver) builds on it. It keeps all three bits after RA (res1, res2, res3), which the harness packs into z. It prints AAAA as eight uncompressed hex groups, which the harness compresses per RFC 5952. Its question parser asserts a single question, so messages with QDCOUNT > 1 are outside its scope. The near-identical forks @luminati-io/native-dns-packet (99.2% shared distinct source lines) and native-node-dns-packet (99.3%) are not counted.
